test_title: PYST 4: SSC CHSL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 02 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
In a certain code language,

'M × N' means 'M is the father of N',

'M + N' means 'M is the wife of N',

'M ÷ N' means 'M is the daughter of N',

'M - N' means 'M is the son of N'.

Based on the above, how is P related to T, if P - Q × R + S × T?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a776c0a19b6706031165c847bcb98978a1e150482bd1260c12a74559ea55407.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 ×
 +
 ÷
 -
 
 

 Meaning
 Father
 Wife
 Daughter
 Son
 
 

 

Given: P - Q × R + S × T

It means: P is the Son of Q, Q is the Father of R, R is the Wife of S, S is the Father of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/862c6d2335f4bf6bfb4d718f7777f4728f9e9f39d46615c797500ca1fd903b0e.png] 

So, P is the **'Mother's brother'** of T.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
